title: 🏛️ RBI Governance Directions — 3-Year Cooling-Off Period After 10-Year Board Tenure in Co-op Banks
summary: RBI proposed amendments to Governance Directions 2025 for UCBs and Rural Co-operative Banks introducing mandatory 3-year cooling-off period for directors completing 10 years continuous tenure before reappointment.
